# Lecture notes

Follow the **lecture-notes** skill for the reading workflow.
To sync with OneNote first, use the **sync-lectures** skill.

Quick reference:
- Each PDF has a sibling folder: `materials/lectures/<name>/`
- `page-XX.ocr.md` — transcription sidecar (read first)
- `page-XX.png` — authoritative image (use when transcription is unclear or missing)
